note: The lab's instruments (GAME_SPEC §13, Readings; Stage 50): each one's resolution and the error it states, and the hand's. A reading is the truth plus an offset drawn once from the bench's seed within the stated error, rounded to the resolution (lab/instruments.hpp). A balance reads a load's conventional mass (OIML D 28): against weights of the reference density in the room's air (docs/DATA_SOURCES.md, The balance).

conductivity_meter.note: (Stage 65) a conductivity meter with its cell: its reading the solution's conductivity at its own temperature (no compensation to 25 C), uS/cm, within its accuracy (a share of the reading), to its range's resolution: the first range whose top is above the reading (uS/cm, resolution)
